# Compositions: Mobile and Tablet Family

---

## Mobile thumb-first

| Aspect | Guidance |
|---|---|
| Solves | One-handed phone use |
| Content needs | Primary action and frequent destinations in the lower half |
| Precedent | Airbnb (ABm1, ABm2) |
| Fails when | Primary actions sit only in the top corners |

## Bottom-navigation workspace

| Aspect | Guidance |
|---|---|
| Solves | Three to five top-level areas on a phone |
| Accessibility | Labels with icons; current tab indicated beyond color |
| Fails when | More than five destinations; used at desktop width without reason (NI2) |

## Contextual sheet system

| Aspect | Guidance |
|---|---|
| Solves | Secondary options without leaving context |
| Fails when | Every interaction opens a sheet (see the bottom-sheet worked example) |

## Split-view tablet

| Aspect | Guidance |
|---|---|
| Solves | List and detail together on tablets and small laptops |
| Responsive | Collapse to push navigation below ~700 px |
